build.summary: kernel layer glm53-flash-sm121:v8 (flashinfer 0.6.18.dev20260819 nightly, nvidia-nccl-cu13 2.30.7, nvidia-cutlass-dsl 4.6.2, glm53-flash_SM121.py sm90 NoPE sparse-MLA+FA2 patch) then serving layer mia/glm53-flash-spark:mm-ray-v1 adding ray[default]==2.58.0, MM env and baked chat_template.jinja

measured.concurrency_notes: x2 31-37 agg, x4 43 agg, x6 64 agg, x8 72 agg (10 tok/s/stream)

extra_setup: Ray cluster (head ray start --head --port 6379 --object-store-memory 4GiB on spark1, worker joins from spark2) over direct CX7 QSFP RoCE link; host NCCL 2.30.7 .so in ~/nccl-2.30.7 bind-mounted to /nccl and LD_PRELOADed; passwordless ssh head->worker; weights rsynced to worker HF cache; chat_template.jinja refreshed from HF main (emit_image/emit_video); image built locally and docker save|load shipped to worker
notes: decode_tps is midpoint of README range 23-30. Model path is the HF snapshot dir (Glm5NextProcessor needs a local processor_config.json), served as the repo id. Per-node values: head CX7_IF=enp1s0f1np1 CX7_IB=rocep1s0f1 NODE_IP=10.0.0.1; worker enp1s0f0np0 / rocep1s0f0 / 10.0.0.2. MOE_BACKEND default marlin (auto tries native NVFP4 MoE and falls back on cudaErrorNoKernelImageForDevice); --enforce-eager appears twice in the real arg list. GPU_MEM_UTIL 0.90 fails the free-mem check on GB10 UMA. Also mounts named volume glm53-flash-cache-sm121 at /root/.cache. A private GHCR copy ghcr.io/miaai-lab/glm53-flash-spark:mm-ray-v1 exists for org members only.
